description:
IB ח94 (דף ב). Draft of a letter from Ḥalfon b. Netanel ha-Levi, perhaps in Damascus, to R. Ḥiyya. In Hebrew and Judaeo-Arabic. Dating: Ca. 1145–46 CE. 
This document was not part of Goitein's original list, but was identified as a Ḥalfon document by M. A. Friedman, who included it in India Book IV. (Hebrew description below; full English to come)
description_he: טיוטת מכתב מחלפון בן נתנאל הלוי, כנראה בדמשק, לר' חיא; בעברית וביהודית-ערבית; כ-1145-46 לספירה
